subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The e2e-review step shall run a human doc-review pass on the rendered design doc alongside the unmanned lenses, both feeding one finding-convergence loop.
rationale: the human half is active review (operator annotations), not just final acceptance
fit_criterion: on the dogfood, the operator's doc-review annotations and the unmanned findings are converged in one loop; the design doc reflects both
